description: Epoch AI 'Polling on AI Usage' dataset (Mar 2026) — survey responses on AI usage broken down by demographic.

body.how_to_read: Long format: one row per (Question, Response); columns are the share giving that response, Overall plus by age/income/education/employment. Demand-side sentiment context, not chip data.

methodology.summary: As-downloaded Epoch AI 'Polling on AI Usage' (Mar 2026) export, copied to blobs on 2026-06-12. Confidence 0.8 (curated CC BY 4.0 dataset).
